summary: Best 47.906 (r3b3_gwx eval 8,123M, CP3, median 47.7%; incumbent 28.841): the greedy line flies the human's whole CP2 sequence, a kill-wrapped block and a thin wall past CP2, CP3 and the descending legs beyond. What did it, on r2b2's scratch band lineage: (1) --time-pen 0 --surf-bonus 0 (the 0.5/s time penalty priced the slow CP2 detour and the cavity dip below an early death; removing it freed a pit-locked checkpoint within 25M steps: 28.2 -> 30.35 -> 32.5); (2) the unstuck T capped at 0.5 (the line breaks at T > 1.5, and at T 1 the stochastic policy cannot even reach the block); (3) greedy-line spawns concentrated near the greedy line's deaths (--respawn-greedy 0.3 --respawn-greedy-window 0.25 2.0): the block fell after ~550M steps, then 32.8 -> 47.9 in ~1.5B. Plus --int-real-only. New code: --respawn-greedy (+window), --int-real-only, --sil-tempered, --sil-top (SIL untested on the box).
